insights.one_liner: CSC is a US business, legal and financial services firm with 8,000+ staff; its two Amsterdam IT jobs here don't require Dutch.

culture.text: A global company based in Wilmington, Delaware, with offices in over 140 jurisdictions and more than 8,000 colleagues.
Its open roles here are mid-level IT, cloud and security jobs in Amsterdam.

open.text: Both of its 2 open jobs here don't require Dutch.
Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor, so a work permit could be harder to arrange.
Its postings draw around 114 applicants each on LinkedIn on average.

worth_knowing.text: Has three Dutch legal entities, including CSC Management (Netherlands) B.V. and CSC Depositary B.V.
